pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against scaling into losing positions; scale-in entries are only permitted after a minimum +$3.00 floating profit has been locked via trailing stop activation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block confirmation combined with a 5-period ATR volatility check to block entries during high-impact news wicks and low-liquidity transition sessions.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressive scaling trigger at +$10.00 profit with mandatory trailing activation locking in at least +$4.00 to prevent floating profits from evaporating.
